title: Close-range A-A pair at rest, initial separation 1.0: constant-K law with K = 11.3 at P = 2.5

claims.statement: Two A particles at rest, initial separation exactly 1.0, duration at most 0.15: each particle accelerates toward the other with magnitude K / r^2.5 (r the current separation, P = 2.5 fixed) and K = 11.3 held constant over the run. Fitted to two lab-a runs (K = 11.52 and 11.05, separation profile at the tracker-noise floor); the K = 18.0 separation-5 value does not apply here.
